title: ACT-THREE - Act Three: Seeking a Custodian
hook: The road softens. The trees do not change, but the air does: warmer, kinder, like a held breath finally letting go. Ahead, lantern-light and music gather around ordinary people who feel safe. Somewhere in this village...
